archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (adapted for Technical Workshop)

typography.instruction: Do not use Inter for headings. Use Manrope. Add IBM Plex Sans for body text. Load them via Google Fonts in index.html.

rules: Use deep obsidian/black base. Tint grey with subtle warm tones.
Never use pure white (#ffffff) for large backgrounds.
Primary CTA should be amber-600/orange-600. Ensure text on primary is white or very light for contrast.
For interactive states, use lighter hue on hover, e.g., hover:bg-amber-500.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for dense data tables, Neumorphism (Crisp) for dashboard widgets. Cards should have 1px solid border with subtle ambient shadow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky headers/mobile nav only: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to break the digital flatness and give a raw 'workshop' feel.

layouts.mobile_first: Single column on mobile, utilizing bottom tab navigation or hamburger menu.
layouts.desktop_grid: High Density Grid (Bento style). Sidebar navigation. Main content area: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing within cards (p-6). Between sections use gap-8 or py-8. Dense data tables can use tighter spacing.
layouts.alignment: Left-align forms and dense data. Right-align numeric values in tables.

components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md), crisp edges, hover state uses slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and shadow-lg.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-card), 1px subtle border (border-border), no massive shadows by default.
components.inputs: Shadcn components, border-border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent.
components.tables: Shadcn Table, alternating row colors (subtle bg-muted/30 on even rows), sticky header.
components.charts: Recharts with lines/bars colored with primary and accent variables. Grid lines should be very subtle (#262626).

motion.page_load: Framer motion for staggered entrance of dashboard widgets (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, stagger: 0.1s).
motion.modals: Scale in from 0.95 and fade in.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast minimums. Use text-foreground for body, text-muted-foreground for secondary.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus-visible ring.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='new-repair-btn').

images.description: Electronics repair shop with clutter, warm lighting
Vintage nixie tube clock glowing orange
Red and black soldering iron on workbench

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required font families (Manrope and IBM Plex Sans) via Google Fonts in public/index.html.
Update tailwind.config.js and index.css with the provided CSS variables for a strict dark theme.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all buttons, links, and forms.
Build the dashboard using a high-density grid for metrics and a detailed Shadcn table for recent repairs.
Implement mobile responsiveness rigorously (sidebar turns into bottom nav or hamburger menu).
Avoid using generic centered layouts; use technical/left-aligned data blocks.
Ensure React component files are generated as .js or .jsx, strictly avoiding .tsx extensions where applicable based on setup.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating headers/navs.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-opacity, etc.).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern button styles (rounded-md, crisp borders) with interaction animations.
NEVER use Emoji characters as icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings, entrance animations).
Use generous padding inside cards (p-6) but tight gaps (gap-4) between data widgets.
Prioritize using existing components from src/components/ui.
